alt.en: Children drawing and painting with watercolours at a shared table in a bright Lisbon-inspired arts studio.

alt.en: Children observing plants and sketching leaves in notebooks beside a garden path in a Lisbon-inspired park.

alt.en: Young children making rhythms with homemade shakers, wooden sticks and buckets in a community music room.

alt.en: Children cooperating around a tabletop board game with wooden tokens and dice in a bright community room.
alt.pt-PT: Crianças a colaborar num jogo de tabuleiro com peças de madeira e dados numa sala comunitária iluminada.

alt.en: Children building paper sculptures with coloured paper, scissors and glue sticks at a makers table.
alt.pt-PT: Crianças a construir esculturas de papel com papel colorido, tesouras e cola numa mesa de criação.
